domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Prepare compatible fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite operands into a subtraction-ready fractional structure by either matching denominators or normalizing whole/fraction/mixed-number forms so whole and fractional parts can be aligned.
skills.merge_rationale: S01 and S02 are both preparatory setup skills that occur before core subtraction. In the dossiers, both serve the same instructional phase: making operands compatible for subtraction. They are distinct at the fine-grained level, but at K=5 the diagnostic distinction between denominator matching and operand normalization is less important than preserving the broader preparation-vs-execution distinction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract whole-number parts and like-denominator fractional parts once the operands are in compatible form.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because this is the core execution step of subtraction and has strong independent diagnostic value distinct from setup, regrouping, and post-processing.

skills.name: Regroup for fractional subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow across the whole-number part by converting one whole into a fraction with the current denominator when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because borrowing/regrouping produces a distinctive error pattern and only occurs in a subset of mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction problems.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or mixed-number expression to lowest terms or simplify zero-fraction results to a whole number or integer.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because simplification is a post-subtraction operation with its own common student errors and should remain diagnostically visible at K=5.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Express the computed result in an acceptable final form by recombining whole and fractional parts or omitting zero parts as appropriate.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because final expression of the answer is a distinct completion step from both simplification and subtraction.
